fato_historico: 1977: German Autumn: A set of events revolving around the kidnapping of Hanns Martin Schleyer and the hijacking of a Lufthansa flight by the Red Army Faction (RAF) comes to an end when Schleyer is murdered and various RAF members allegedly commit suicide.
energia_do_dia: Today, the celestial currents suggest a peaceful conclusion to turbulent cycles. Much like the fading echoes of past conflicts resolving into stillness, your inner world may find a profound sense of closure. It is a good time to release heavy burdens, embrace tranquility, and let your analytical mind rest while you cultivate harmony in your daily routines and personal connections.
frase_do_dia: True peace emerges when you let go of what you cannot change.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a challenging phase and building new foundations.
conselho: Consider stepping back from busy tasks to breathe and honor your inner calm.
